short_description: Research and write defensible best-of articles.
description: Create evidence-backed listicles and product roundups with transparent ranking criteria and optional SandBase SERP, page, review, and screenshot research.

requires: User-provided evidence or an authorized SandBase connection for live research

install.prompt: Use $listicle-blog-writer to research and draft this best-of article.
install.cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill listicle-blog-writer --agent codex
install.global_cli: npx skills add sandbaseai/sandbase-skills --skill listicle-blog-writer --agent codex --global

examples: Compare the best CRM tools for a five-person sales team using transparent criteria.
Turn these product test notes into a current best-of article without new web research.
Research and draft an answer-engine-friendly roundup with verified prices and screenshots.

optional_inputs: ranking criteria and hands-on test notes

notes: A publisher-owned or sponsored product is not automatically ranked first.
Official pages support feature and price facts but are not independent reviews.
Live research uses dynamically discovered SandBase capabilities and requires cost confirmation.
Without live evidence, current claims remain explicitly marked as unverified.

endpoints.summary: Discover current SERP, keyword, scraping, review, and screenshot capabilities.
Inspect live schemas, market controls, pricing, and execution behavior.
Execute an approved research or screenshot capability.
Recover recent run status and actual cost.
Check balance before a paid research batch.
